qualification.intendedScreen: iPad and iPhone Home Screen app icon
mustNotShow: Text, letters, numbers, third-party logos, unrelated UI, transparency, frightening material, or hard clipping of the central treehouse and planet
mustShow: One centered pink and lavender fantasy treehouse perched on a compact blue-violet planet
A broad rainbow, sparkling pastel orbital ring, warm glowing windows, soft cloud framing, and two small friendly star mascots
A bright full-bleed square composition whose central magical-world silhouette remains readable at small app-icon size
safeZones: Keep the treehouse, planet, rainbow, orbital ring, and star mascots readable within Apple's rounded app-icon mask; decorative clouds and background color may extend into cropped corner regions
